red_cases.evidence: post-GREEN test 'RED pre-enable gate': fixture flipping unattendedRelease.enabled=true on the committed example registration -> validate exit=2 PRE_ENABLE_REGISTRATION_INCOMPLETE with the 7-item missing list (external monitor, both platform on-call entries, both channels, delivery authorization, isolation-operation authorization). The complete fixture (all REGISTERED + authorizationRecord) passes the structural gate -> exit=0, proving the gate is the registration, not the flag. Committed receipt: preEnableGate.allowed=false with all 7 missing.

red_cases.case: Comet process death injected — provable locally at process level
red_cases.evidence: RED: probe --case runner-process-failure MODULE_NOT_FOUND (evidence/red-cli.txt). GREEN: real injection — the probe spawns a real node child writing a 50ms heartbeat, reads fresh heartbeat, SIGKILLs it, confirms the old writer terminated (kill(pid,0) ESRCH after exit reap), detects heartbeat staleness >400ms (scaled timescale; contract deadlines recorded alongside), then supervised-restarts the SAME authority id (new pid, old pid dead, exactly one live instance, 1 restart <= budget 3). Receipt evidence/green-probe-runner-process-failure.json: executed=true status=VERIFIED capabilityScope=PROCESS_LEVEL, all 5 observedSteps VERIFIED, hostFailureCapabilityClaimed=false — the process proof is never smuggled as a host-failure capability.

red_cases.case: monitor co-hosted with the runner cannot PASS host-failure detection — fault domain must be FAIL, not PASS
red_cases.evidence: RED: probe --case external-host-down MODULE_NOT_FOUND. GREEN: no real external monitoring instance exists (registration status UNREGISTERED) -> structured UNVERIFIED exit=2 (evidence/green-probe-external-host-down.json): faultDomainSatisfied=false, mustNotPass=true, reason states a co-hosted monitor dies with the host, requiredInputs + plannedSteps listed, no skip:true. Structural backstop: fault-domain-policy flipping coHostedMonitorMustNotPassHostFailure=false -> validate exit=2 COHOSTED_CLAIM_FORBIDDEN (post-GREEN test 'RED fault-domain gate').

red_cases.case: first isolation failure immediate event undelivered / primary channel failure fails over to backup / unacknowledged on-call escalates — three segments timed separately from real timestamps
red_cases.evidence: post-GREEN test 'Monitor.v1 three-segment timing': green timeline (primary unreachable -> backup delivered in 25s, unacked, escalated after >=300s) -> exit=0 with three separate fields detectionSeconds/deliverySeconds/escalationSeconds and failover.used=true; no totalDeliverySeconds field can exist (structural: adding one -> exit=2 SEGMENTS_NOT_SEPARATE; dropping any segment -> exit=2). Negative: detection 190s -> DETECTION_DEADLINE_BREACH; delivery 45s (detection in budget) -> DELIVERY_TARGET_BREACH — proving segments are judged separately; undelivered + ackedAt -> UNDELIVERED_MARKED_ACKED; unacked without escalation -> ESCALATION_MISSING. Unauthorized send claim -> SEND_WITHOUT_AUTHORIZATION. All alerts produced without authorization are PREPARE_ONLY with sentByThisTool=false (the current task implies no notification-send authorization).

red_cases.case: supervisor overreach: changing phase / creating a Comet maintenance operation / writing Outline ACL directly is refused (process-level restart of the original instance only)
red_cases.evidence: post-GREEN test 'Supervisor.v1: out-of-scope actions are refused': all six actions (change-phase, create-maintenance-operation, write-outline-acl, copy-state, start-second-owner, business-retry) -> supervise exit=2 FORBIDDEN_ACTION_REFUSED decision=REFUSED. Structural backstop: removing any of the six from supervisor-policy forbiddenActions -> validate exit=2 SUPERVISOR_ACTIONS_INCOMPLETE; cometSelfRecovery.supervisorBusinessRetry=false is enforced (SUPERVISOR_BUSINESS_RETRY_FORBIDDEN) — Comet recovers its own transactions/compensation/retries.

red_cases.case: dual start while the old writer is not quarantined is refused; restart budget (3 per 5 minutes) exceeded -> stop + escalate
red_cases.evidence: post-GREEN tests: oldWriterAlive=true -> exit=2 OLD_WRITER_ALIVE_REFUSED; storageOwnershipKnown=false -> exit=2 STORAGE_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN_REFUSED; 3 restarts inside the 300s window + a 4th request -> exit=2 RESTART_BUDGET_EXCEEDED decision=STOP_AND_ESCALATE with a PREPARE_ONLY escalation to the platform on-call; 3 restarts all outside the window -> exit=0 withinBudget=true (window arithmetic uses real timestamps). Structural backstops: maxRestarts=10 or onExceeded=CONTINUE_RESTARTING -> RESTART_BUDGET_INVALID; refuseWhileOldWriterAlive=ALLOW -> START_GATE_REFUSE_REQUIRED.

red_cases.case: cross-project refs rejected; missing registration refused at resolution (I01 semantics)
red_cases.evidence: post-GREEN test 'RED I01 isolation': fixture credentialRef secret-ref:pav-legacy/monitor-alert -> validate exit=2 CROSS_PROJECT_REF. monitor-health-read (absent from the I01 catalog): validate reports the explicit catalogGap (exit 0, I01-owned gap) and resolveSecretRef throws REF_NOT_REGISTERED with the monitor principal (asserted against the real committed catalog); monitor-alert with the same principal resolves read-only status=UNRESOLVED resolved=false — never a value.

green_summary.Health.v1: tools/infra/monitor.mjs health --facts: read-only evaluation over existing Comet facts (sourceOfTruth=existing-comet-facts, readOnly=true enforced structurally). Read model: heartbeat_age, receive_cursor (observed, no threshold invented — thresholdStatus UNVERIFIED), complete_scan_watermark, unresolved_isolation + deadlines, authority identity. Heartbeat age >90s -> HEARTBEAT_AGE_ALERT; scan watermark >120s -> SCAN_WATERMARK_STALL with heartbeatIndependent=true; the stalled-scan scenario with a fresh heartbeat fires ONLY the stall breach (independence proven both ways). Overdue isolation deadline -> ISOLATION_DEADLINE_BREACH; missing authorityId -> AUTHORITY_IDENTITY_MISSING. Contract deadlines frozen in health-contract.json and re-asserted by validate (DEADLINE_CONTRACT_INVALID on tamper). Exit 0 healthy / 2 breach / 1 missing-unparseable facts. realCometReadback stays honestly UNVERIFIED (facts files are declared inputs; real readback needs the external monitor + monitor-health-read ref).
green_summary.Monitor.v1: alert --facts prepares alerts (HEARTBEAT_AGE_ALERT / SCAN_WATERMARK_STALL / ISOLATION_FAILURE_IMMEDIATE) with per-alert detectedAt; delivery is PREPARE_ONLY with sentByThisTool=false because monitor-registration carries alertDeliveryAuthorized=false (the task implies no send authorization); a timeline claiming sentByThisTool=true without a recorded authorization -> SEND_WITHOUT_AUTHORIZATION. alert --timeline evaluates the three segments separately from real ISO timestamps: detection <=120s, delivery <=30s (primary unreachable -> backup failover recorded, undelivered never marked acknowledged), escalation for unacked alerts (>=300s recommended ack timeout, freezeStatus UNVERIFIED_RECOMMENDED — the recommended value still needs owner freeze). A combined total-delivery budget is structurally forbidden (forbiddenCombinedBudgetFields + SEGMENTS_NOT_SEPARATE). Unattended-release pre-enable gate: enabled=true requires all seven registered prerequisites including the authorization record, else PRE_ENABLE_REGISTRATION_INCOMPLETE exit 2; delivery-authorization claims without a record are DELIVERY_AUTHORIZATION_CLAIM_FORBIDDEN (I06 protection-claim guard pattern).
green_summary.Supervisor.v1: supervise --request: decisions only — restart is the sole allowed action (six overreach actions refused with FORBIDDEN_ACTION_REFUSED); start gate refuses while the old writer is unconfirmed-terminated (OLD_WRITER_ALIVE_REFUSED) or storage ownership is unknown (STORAGE_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN_REFUSED); restart budget 3 per 300s window from real timestamps, exhaustion -> STOP_AND_ESCALATE with a PREPARE_ONLY escalation to the platform on-call. ALLOW receipts carry authorityIdentity mode=SAME_FIXED_AUTHORITY_ONLY with stateCopy/secondBusinessOwner FORBIDDEN, cometSelfRecovery (transactions/compensation/retry true, supervisorBusinessRetry false), recoveryTargetSeconds=600 with recoveryFreezeStatus=UNVERIFIED_RECOMMENDED, executed=false (a decision receipt is not a process restart). The actual process-level restart capability is proven by the probe: spawn -> SIGKILL -> confirm old writer gone -> same-authority respawn -> exactly one live instance, restart audit recorded (restartsUsed=1 vs budget 3).
green_summary.FaultDomain.v1 + validate: fault-domain-policy.json separates runnerProcessFailure (PROCESS_LEVEL, provable on the runner host — may be marked complete) from runnerHostFailure (requiresExternalMonitor, coHostedMonitorInsufficient, 120s latest discovery — can never PASS from a co-hosted claim; the probe external-host-down returns UNVERIFIED with faultDomainSatisfied=false and mustNotPass=true). monitor-self-failure is discoverable only by the existing platform monitoring; an unregistered monitor keeps the admission gap open. validate checks all five domain files fail-closed: interfaces, project binding to infra/delivery/registry.json, example declaration, frozen deadlines (30/30/90/120/120/30/300/3-per-300/600), pre-enable gate, delivery-authorization claim guard, segment separation, undelivered-ack rule, noBusinessWrites completeness, supervisor structure (forbiddenActions/budget/startGate/authorityBinding/cometSelfRecovery), co-host guard, secret-ref format + project namespace + forbidden-value scans, catalogGaps reported explicitly (monitor-health-read). Exit contract 0/1/2 per V_INFRA_I07.cli_contract; host-path redaction on all structured output; zero new npm dependencies; all negative fixtures in os.tmpdir().
